propositions: BindingRepository must own and preserve exact byte layout and sorted/indented JSON serialization with trailing newlines for live, retired, rotation, and alert files without eager writes on construction

Unconditional save must attempt rotation persistence before live replacement, preserving inline last_get_pass floor in live if rotation tempfile/write/replace fails and subsequent saves must converge the sidecar from the retained inline floor
Corrupt live JSON raises ValueError and preserves the file; corrupt retired JSON returns empty, preserves the file, and attempts best-effort deduped alerting with failure swallowed
Failed retired or live tempfile/write/replace operations during persistence must clean temps, preserve old state files, and raise exceptions; rotation failure alone is swallowed
Live replacement failure during retirement must keep retired new, live old, clean temps, and raise; alert persistence failure must not alter successful state-file writes
